SPECIALIST AQUATIC SYSTEMS

Specialist Aquatic Systems.
Designed for Performance.

Deep Blue Aquatic Systems designs, manufactures, supplies and installs specialised water systems for aquaculture, live holding, commercial aquariums, water-quality monitoring and specialist swimming pools.

SERVICE 01 • AQUACULTURE

Complete Aquaculture Solutions (Freshwater & Marine)

Deep Blue Aqua designs and supplies systems for freshwater and marine aquaculture applications. Our capabilities range from individual filtration components to complete turnkey hatchery, grow-out and research facilities. Systems are engineered specifically around your species, production volumes, water sources and operational requirements.

  • Turnkey and component-based systems for on-land fish and shellfish production
  • Hatcheries, broodstock systems, larval rearing and juvenile grow-out units
  • Research and development facilities and aquaponics integration
  • Freshwater and marine environment engineering tailored to species biology
Discuss an Aquaculture Project
SERVICE 02 • RAS

Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS)

Recirculating Aquaculture Systems allow water to be treated and reused rather than continuously discharged. Deep Blue Aqua has extensive experience in the design and installation of RAS solutions, providing greater control over culture conditions while dramatically reducing water requirements, biosecurity risks and environmental discharge.

  • Mechanical filtration: High-capacity automatic self-cleaning drum filters
  • Biofiltration: Moving-bed biofilters (MBBR) and fixed-film biological reactors
  • Foam fractionation (protein skimming) for fine organic solids removal
  • Oxygenation, degassing, temperature control and automated monitoring loops
Explore RAS Solutions
SERVICE 03 • LIVE HOLDING

Live Holding Systems for Valuable Aquatic Product

Live seafood requires carefully controlled water conditions between capture, storage, processing and export. Deep Blue Aqua designs live-holding systems for species such as lobster, abalone, shellfish and other high-value aquatic products. Systems incorporate filtration, cooling, circulation, oxygenation and monitoring to maintain stable water conditions and reduce mortality.

  • Pre-export live holding facilities for lobster, abalone and shellfish
  • Biological purging systems and temperature-regulated chilling circuits
  • Land-based holding facilities and specialised fishing vessel live-wells
  • Continuous dissolved oxygen control and ammonia/nitrite safety systems
Talk to Us About Live Holding
SERVICE 04 • LIFE-SUPPORT

Life-Support Systems Designed Around Aquatic Life

Deep Blue Aqua supplies filtration, circulation, treatment and monitoring equipment for commercial and specialist aquarium applications. We deliver life-support systems (LSS) designed specifically around the welfare, health and vitality of diverse marine and freshwater exhibits.

  • Public aquariums, marine educational exhibits and public display tanks
  • Aquatic rehabilitation centres, sea turtle rescue and marine research labs
  • Skid-mounted plug-and-play filtration for live seafood restaurant displays
  • Biological filtration, protein skimmers, UV sterilisation and climate control
Enquire About Aquarium Systems
SERVICE 05 • MONITORING & CONTROL

See What Is Happening in Your Water (Monitoring & Control)

Reliable water management starts with reliable information. Deep Blue Aqua supplies water-quality monitoring and control solutions for aquaculture, live holding, aquariums, water-treatment works and mining. Systems range from handheld instruments to permanent multi-parameter installations with data logging, remote access and automated fail-safes.

  • Optical dissolved oxygen (DO) sensors with automated oxygen dosing
  • Multi-parameter probes: pH, temperature, conductivity, salinity and ORP
  • 24/7 continuous cloud data logging, remote dashboards and automated SMS alerts
  • Custom electrical switchgear, VSD starter panels and PLC automated control
Explore Monitoring Solutions
SERVICE 06 • SPECIALIST POOLS

Filtration for Pools That Demand More

Not every swimming pool presents the same filtration challenge. Deep Blue Aqua focuses on specialist applications where dependable water treatment, high-rate circulation and crystal clarity are especially important, including large school pools, commercial competition pools, natural swimming pools and biological eco-pools.

  • Large school swimming pools and 50m outdoor Olympic pools
  • Commercial aquatic facilities, club pools and heavy bather-load filtration
  • Natural swimming pools and eco-pools combining natural plants with pure water
  • Rim-flow hydraulic balancing, high-efficiency media filtration and upgrades
Discuss Specialist Pool Filtration
SERVICE 07 • DESIGN & SUPPLY

Design, Consulting & Specialist Equipment Supply

Successful projects depend on rigorous planning before the first pipe is installed. Deep Blue Aqua provides specialist design and technical consulting services alongside direct supply of industrial-grade aquaculture materials, tanks, pumps, filtration and control equipment.

  • Conceptual and AutoCAD drawings, production modelling & feasibility studies
  • Financial model analysis, project due diligence, and system troubleshooting
  • Supply of GRP and HDPE tanks, PVC and GRP piping, blowers, and water pumps
  • Supply of drum filters, biofilter media, switchgear, and international sensor gear
Request Technical Consulting
